description: How do you spell this medicine? Suggests correctly spelt drug names for a misspelt or misheard one (e.g. 'ambienn' to 'ambien'), from the U.S. National Library of Medicine RxNorm spelling service. Useful for voice and OCR input, chat agents and anyone typing a prescription name from memory. Suggestions are names in the US RxNorm vocabulary only, without strengths; they say nothing about whether a drug is right for anyone. (cost: 1 credit)

name.description: string, required, the drug name as typed or heard (e.g. "ambienn")

name: drug_spelling_suggest
